source.title: The City That Brewed Itself: How Portland Became America's Coffee Capital Without Growing a Single Bean

episode.episode_title: The City That Brewed Itself: How Portland Became America's Coffee Capital Without Growing a Single Bean
episode.episode_summary: An interview with the author of an investigative piece on Portland's coffee economy. They discuss the city's paradoxical status as a global coffee hub despite importing all its beans, the history of third-wave roasters like Stumptown and Heart, the infrastructure of microroasters at Buckman, and the economic fragility introduced by recent federal tariffs on imports.
